title: Knockturn Alley Book Nook
desc: The miniature alley opens between two rows of weathered buildings, with glowing shop windows, stairways, and surprises tucked into the scene.

title: A Peek Inside the Book Nook
desc: Seen through the framed opening, the narrow alley gives the illusion of a street stretching farther into the distance.

title: Down the Cobblestone Alley
desc: Warm streetlamps and glowing storefront windows guide the eye along the narrow, atmospheric passage.

title: The Alley After Dark
desc: Blue, green, and purple light from the windows gives this view between the buildings a mysterious nighttime feeling.

title: The Diagon Alley Entrance
desc: An arched passage marked by a tiny Diagon Alley sign sits among brick walls and shop windows. Look closely for the Mail Owl flying toward you!

title: Borgin and Burkes
desc: The curved shop windows, hanging sign, and weathered doors make this storefront worth exploring up close.

title: Cauldrons Outside the Shop
desc: Stacked cauldrons stand beside the windows of Borgin and Burkes, with little details visible inside the shop.

title: Skulls in the Window
desc: Look closely at the lighted windowpanes to spot the skulls peering out from behind the glass.

title: Bones, Barrels, and Broomsticks
desc: A barrel of bones, a bundle of broomsticks, and Hermione near the doorway fill this corner of the alley.

title: The Skeleton by the Stairs
desc: A skeleton sits on a crate beneath the wooden stairs and a red-glowing window.

title: The Hidden Staircase
desc: Tiny doors, winding stairs, and Wesley on the landing add another layer of detail above the alley.

title: The Daily Prophet Sign
desc: A miniature hanging newspaper sign adds a recognizable detail against the weathered wall and glowing blue window.

title: A Glowing Streetlamp
desc: Even this tiny streetlamp has character, casting warm light against the rough wooden siding.

title: Colorful Windows and a Winding Pipe
desc: A twisting pipe climbs the brick wall beside the tall, green-lit window.

title: A Glimpse Down the Passage
desc: The close viewpoint and shallow focus create a mysterious view through the narrow alley.

title: Building the Wooden Facade
desc: One of the building fronts photographed separately, showing the weathered siding, miniature doors, and window frames.

title: Building the Brick Wall
desc: A separate wall panel reveals the textured brickwork and winding pipe that help give the finished scene its character.
